description: Evolution of the number of light signals on the Infrabel network is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Jaarlijkse evolutie van het aantal grote en kleine stopseinen op het Infrabel-netwerk. Klein of groot, wat is het verschil? Grote seinen zijn lichtseinen die altijd verhoogd zijn opgesteld en die zich richten tot de grote of kleine bewegingen. De verwittigingsseinen maken deel uit van deze categorie. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Seinen, Veiligheid, Traffic beheer. The portal shows 204 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
